# Overview

This Rmd quantifies **tissue directionality** of miRNAs detected in the union
negative-cosine-similarity pairs (`negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv`).

Three complementary approaches are used:

| Method | What it measures | Non-independence handling |
|---|---|---|
| **Tau index** | Tissue specificity of each miRNA (0 = ubiquitous, 1 = specific) | N/A (descriptive) |
| **Fisher's exact test** | Enrichment of each miRNA in each tissue vs. all others | Bonferroni / BH correction |
| **GLMM** | Tissue membership modelled with miRNA and mRNA as random effects | `(1\|miRNA_Name) + (1\|SYMBOL)` |

# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)       # GLMM: glmer()
library(blme)       # Bayesian GLMM: bglmer() with weakly informative priors
library(broom.mixed)# tidy() for lme4 objects
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna     <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"
tissue_order <- c("hypo", "liver", "panc", "gut", "ewat", "iwat", "bat", "gas", "sol")
N_TISSUES    <- length(tissue_order)

# Tau classification thresholds
TAU_HIGH <- 0.70   # >= HIGH -> tissue-specific
TAU_LOW  <- 0.30   # <= LOW  -> ubiquitous

find_union_pairs_csv <- function() {
  base <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "02_integration")
  dated_dirs <- sort(list.dirs(base, recursive = FALSE), decreasing = TRUE)
  for (d in dated_dirs) {
    p <- file.path(d, "union", "negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv")
    if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  }
  stop("negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv not found")
}

union_csv <- find_union_pairs_csv()
out_dir   <- dirname(union_csv)

cat("Input :", union_csv, "\n")
cat("Output:", out_dir,   "\n")
```

# 3. Load and prepare data

```{r load}
pairs <- read.csv(union_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    tissue        = factor(tissue, levels = tissue_order),
    miRNA_cluster = factor(as.character(miRNA_cluster))
  )

cat("Total pairs   :", nrow(pairs),                     "\n")
cat("Unique miRNAs :", n_distinct(pairs$miRNA_Name),    "\n")
cat("Unique mRNAs  :", n_distinct(pairs$SYMBOL),        "\n")
cat("Tissues       :", paste(levels(pairs$tissue), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 4. miRNA × tissue count matrix

Rows = miRNA, columns = tissue, values = number of mRNA pairs.
Missing tissue–miRNA combinations are filled with 0.

```{r count-matrix}
mirna_tissue_counts <- pairs %>%
  count(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster, tissue, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  complete(miRNA_Name, tissue = factor(tissue_order, levels = tissue_order),
           fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(miRNA_Name) %>%
  fill(miRNA_cluster, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

# Wide format for display
count_wide <- mirna_tissue_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tissue, values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(all_of(tissue_order))))

cat("miRNA x tissue count matrix (head):\n")
print(head(count_wide))

write.csv(count_wide,
          file.path(out_dir, "miRNA_tissue_count_matrix.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: miRNA_tissue_count_matrix.csv\n")
```

# 5. Tau index

The **Tau index** (Yanai et al. 2005) measures tissue specificity using the
per-miRNA distribution of pair counts across tissues:

$$
\tau_i = \frac{\sum_{j=1}^{N} \left(1 - \hat{x}_{ij}\right)}{N - 1},
\quad \hat{x}_{ij} = \frac{x_{ij}}{\max_j x_{ij}}
$$

$\tau = 1$ → all pairs concentrated in one tissue;
$\tau = 0$ → perfectly uniform across all tissues.
miRNAs with total pairs = 0 (not applicable here) or max = 0 receive NA.

Two variants are computed, differing in the input $x_{ij}$:

| Variant | $x_{ij}$ | Rationale |
|---------|-----------|-----------|
| **Raw** | $c_{ij}$ — raw pair count of miRNA $i$ in tissue $j$ | Standard Tau; reflects absolute pair distribution |
| **Normalized** | $c_{ij} / M_j$ — pair count divided by total pairs in tissue $j$ | Removes tissue-level detection bias (e.g. ewat having more detectable target pairs overall) |

where $M_j = \sum_i c_{ij}$ is the total number of pairs detected in tissue $j$.
Normalization ensures that a miRNA appearing uniformly across all tissues is not
spuriously classified as tissue-specific merely because one tissue has higher
overall detection depth.

```{r tau}
compute_tau <- function(x) {
  if (all(x == 0) || max(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  xhat <- x / max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  sum(1 - xhat) / (length(x) - 1)
}

mirna_cluster_lut <- pairs %>%
  distinct(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster)

# Per-tissue total pairs M_j (used for normalization)
tissue_total <- pairs %>%
  count(tissue, name = "M_j") %>%
  mutate(tissue = as.character(tissue))

cat("Total pairs per tissue (M_j):\n")
print(arrange(tissue_total, desc(M_j)))

# Helper: build tau_df from a counts data frame; x_col = column used for tau
build_tau_df <- function(counts_long, x_col) {
  counts_long %>%
    group_by(miRNA_Name) %>%
    summarise(
      tau        = compute_tau(.data[[x_col]]),
      n_total    = sum(n),       # always raw pair count
      n_tissues  = sum(n > 0),   # always raw pair count
      top_tissue = {
        idx <- which.max(.data[[x_col]])
        if (length(idx) == 0) NA_character_ else as.character(tissue[idx])
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(mirna_cluster_lut, by = "miRNA_Name") %>%
    mutate(
      specificity = case_when(
        tau >= TAU_HIGH ~ "tissue-specific",
        tau <= TAU_LOW  ~ "ubiquitous",
        TRUE            ~ "intermediate"
      ) %>% factor(levels = c("tissue-specific", "intermediate", "ubiquitous"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(tau))
}

# Raw Tau: x_ij = raw pair count
tau_df <- build_tau_df(mirna_tissue_counts, "n")

# Normalized Tau: x_ij / M_j removes tissue-level detection bias
mirna_tissue_norm <- mirna_tissue_counts %>%
  mutate(tissue_chr = as.character(tissue)) %>%
  left_join(tissue_total, by = c("tissue_chr" = "tissue")) %>%
  mutate(n_norm = n / M_j)

tau_norm_df <- build_tau_df(mirna_tissue_norm, "n_norm")

cat("\nRaw Tau summary:\n");       print(tau_df,      n = Inf)
cat("\nNormalized Tau summary:\n"); print(tau_norm_df, n = Inf)

cat("\nSpecificity (raw):\n");        print(table(tau_df$specificity))
cat("\nSpecificity (normalized):\n"); print(table(tau_norm_df$specificity))

write.csv(tau_df,
          file.path(out_dir, "miRNA_tau_index.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
write.csv(tau_norm_df,
          file.path(out_dir, "miRNA_tau_index_normalized.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: miRNA_tau_index.csv / miRNA_tau_index_normalized.csv\n")
```

## 5a. Tau index bar chart

```{r tau-bar, fig.height=5, fig.width=18}
CLUST_COLORS <- c("1" = "#B3E2CD", "2" = "#FDCDAC", "3" = "#CBD5E8",
                  "4" = "#F4CAE4", "5" = "#FFF2AE")
SPEC_SHAPES  <- c("tissue-specific" = 8, "intermediate" = 21, "ubiquitous" = 16)

make_tau_bar_plot <- function(df, subtitle_extra) {
  plot_data <- df %>%
    mutate(
      miRNA_short = sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name),
      miRNA_short = factor(miRNA_short, levels = rev(unique(miRNA_short)))
    )
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = miRNA_short, y = tau, fill = miRNA_cluster)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = TAU_LOW,  linetype = "dashed",
               color = "#2166ac", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = TAU_HIGH, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "#d6604d", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = top_tissue), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8, color = "grey30") +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Cluster", values = CLUST_COLORS) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.15), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    annotate("text", x = nrow(plot_data) + 0.3, y = TAU_HIGH + 0.02,
             label = paste0("tissue-specific\n(τ ≥" , TAU_HIGH, ")"),
             hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "#d6604d") +
    annotate("text", x = nrow(plot_data) + 0.3, y = TAU_LOW - 0.02,
             label = paste0("ubiquitous\n(τ ≤", TAU_LOW, ")"),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3, color = "#2166ac") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Tau index — ", subtitle_extra),
      subtitle = paste0("n tissues = ", N_TISSUES, "  |  label = tissue with most pairs"),
      x = NULL, y = "τ (Tau index)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

p_tau_raw  <- make_tau_bar_plot(tau_df,      "raw counts")
p_tau_norm <- make_tau_bar_plot(tau_norm_df, "normalized by tissue total pairs")
p_tau_both <- p_tau_raw | p_tau_norm

print(p_tau_both)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tau_index_barplot.svg"),
       p_tau_raw,  width = 9, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tau_index_barplot.png"),
       p_tau_raw,  width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tau_index_barplot_norm.svg"),
       p_tau_norm, width = 9, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tau_index_barplot_norm.png"),
       p_tau_norm, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tau_index_barplot_both.svg"),
       p_tau_both, width = 18, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tau_index_barplot_both.png"),
       p_tau_both, width = 18, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: tau_index_barplot*.svg / .png\n")
```

    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +

    facet_grid(top_tissue ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +

      title    = paste0("Tau index by top tissue — ", subtitle_extra),

}

# 6. Fisher's exact test (miRNA × tissue enrichment)

For each miRNA $i$ and tissue $j$, a 2×2 contingency table is constructed:

|  | tissue $j$ | other tissues |
|---|---|---|
| miRNA $i$ | $a$ | $b$ |
| other miRNAs | $c$ | $d$ |

where counts are the number of mRNA pairs.
One-sided Fisher's exact test (greater), BH correction across all
`r n_distinct(pairs$miRNA_Name)` × `r N_TISSUES` cells.

```{r fisher}
mirna_list  <- unique(pairs$miRNA_Name)
tissue_list <- tissue_order

fisher_results <- expand_grid(miRNA_Name = mirna_list,
                              tissue     = tissue_list) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    a = sum(pairs$miRNA_Name == miRNA_Name & pairs$tissue == tissue),
    b = sum(pairs$miRNA_Name == miRNA_Name & pairs$tissue != tissue),
    c = sum(pairs$miRNA_Name != miRNA_Name & pairs$tissue == tissue),
    d = sum(pairs$miRNA_Name != miRNA_Name & pairs$tissue != tissue),
    p_value   = tryCatch(
      fisher.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2),
                  alternative = "greater")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    odds_ratio = tryCatch(
      fisher.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2),
                  alternative = "greater")$estimate,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    sig   = case_when(
      p_adj   < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
      TRUE           ~ "n.s."
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(tau_df %>% dplyr::select(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster),
            by = "miRNA_Name") %>%
  arrange(p_adj, p_value)

cat("Fisher results (significant FDR < 0.05):\n")
fisher_results %>%
  filter(sig == "FDR < 0.05") %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA_Name, tissue, a, b, c, d,
                odds_ratio, p_value, p_adj) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

write.csv(fisher_results,
          file.path(out_dir, "miRNA_tissue_fisher.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: miRNA_tissue_fisher.csv\n")
```

## 6a. Heatmap: -log10(p_adj) per miRNA × tissue

```{r s4f_mirna_order}
# Replicate S4f miRNA order: cluster (ascending) then n_pairs descending within cluster
s4f_mirna_order <- pairs %>%
  group_by(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(n_pairs = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    miRNA_short   = sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name),
    miRNA_cluster = factor(as.character(miRNA_cluster),
                           levels = as.character(sort(unique(as.integer(
                             as.character(miRNA_cluster))))))
  ) %>%
  arrange(miRNA_cluster, desc(n_pairs)) %>%
  pull(miRNA_short)

# Cluster positions along s4f_mirna_order for boundary lines and labels
mirna_cluster_short <- pairs %>%
  distinct(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  mutate(miRNA_short = sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name))

s4f_cluster_seq <- tibble(miRNA_short = s4f_mirna_order) %>%
  left_join(mirna_cluster_short, by = "miRNA_short") %>%
  mutate(pos = row_number(),
         miRNA_cluster = as.character(miRNA_cluster))

# Horizontal boundary positions (between clusters)
boundary_pos <- s4f_cluster_seq %>%
  group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(last_pos = max(pos), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  slice(-n()) %>%
  pull(last_pos) + 0.5

# Cluster label midpoints
cluster_mid <- s4f_cluster_seq %>%
  group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(mid_pos = mean(pos), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(miRNA_cluster)

# Reversed order (Cluster5 at bottom → Cluster1 at top): boundary and midpoints
cluster_sizes_rev <- s4f_cluster_seq %>%
  group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(miRNA_cluster)) %>%
  mutate(
    end_pos   = cumsum(n),
    start_pos = end_pos - n + 1,
    mid_pos   = (start_pos + end_pos) / 2
  )

boundary_pos_rev <- cluster_sizes_rev$end_pos[-nrow(cluster_sizes_rev)] + 0.5
cluster_mid_rev  <- cluster_sizes_rev %>% dplyr::select(miRNA_cluster, mid_pos)
```

```{r fisher-heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=14}
fisher_heat <- fisher_results %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_padj = pmin(-log10(p_adj + 1e-10), 5),  # cap at 5
    miRNA_short    = sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name),
    tissue         = factor(tissue, levels = tissue_order),
    # * = FDR < 0.05; # = nominal p < 0.05
    label_sig      = case_when(
      sig == "FDR < 0.05" ~ "*",
      sig == "p < 0.05"   ~ "#",
      TRUE                ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  # rev() puts Cluster5 at bottom, Cluster1 at top
  mutate(miRNA_short = factor(miRNA_short, levels = rev(s4f_mirna_order)))

# Dynamic ggsave dimensions: square cells
n_mirna_heat  <- length(s4f_mirna_order)
fig_w_heat    <- 8
cell_in       <- (fig_w_heat - 2.5) / length(tissue_order)
fig_h_heat    <- max(5, cell_in * n_mirna_heat + 2)

p_fish_heat <- ggplot(fisher_heat,
                      aes(x = tissue, y = miRNA_short,
                          fill = neg_log10_padj)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = fisher_heat %>% filter(sig != "n.s."),
            aes(label = label_sig),
            size = 3, color = "grey30", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = boundary_pos_rev,
             color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "solid") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#d6604d",
                      name = "-log10(FDR)\n\n* FDR < 0.05\n# p < 0.05",
                      limits = c(0, 5)) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = length(tissue_order) + 0.6,
           y     = cluster_mid_rev$mid_pos,
           label = paste0("C", cluster_mid_rev$miRNA_cluster),
           size = 3, hjust = 0, color = "grey20", fontface = "bold") +
  coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title    = "Fisher's exact test: miRNA enrichment per tissue",
    subtitle = "One-sided (greater); BH correction",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 30, 5, 5),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_fish_heat)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "fisher_heatmap_padj.svg"),
       p_fish_heat, width = fig_w_heat, height = fig_h_heat, limitsize = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "fisher_heatmap_padj.png"),
       p_fish_heat, width = fig_w_heat, height = fig_h_heat, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Saved: fisher_heatmap_padj.svg / .png  (%.1f x %.1f in)\n",
            fig_w_heat, fig_h_heat))
```

## 6b. Odds ratio heatmap

```{r or-heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=14}
or_heat <- fisher_results %>%
  mutate(
    log2OR      = log2(pmax(odds_ratio, 0.01)),   # floor at 0.01 to avoid -Inf
    miRNA_short = sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name),
    tissue      = factor(tissue, levels = tissue_order),
    # * = FDR < 0.05; # = nominal p < 0.05
    label_sig   = case_when(
      sig == "FDR < 0.05" ~ "*",
      sig == "p < 0.05"   ~ "#",
      TRUE                ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(miRNA_short = factor(miRNA_short, levels = rev(s4f_mirna_order)))

# Symmetric scale: cap at the 95th percentile of |log2OR|
or_limit <- quantile(abs(or_heat$log2OR[is.finite(or_heat$log2OR)]), 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("log2OR colour limit (95th pctile of |log2OR|): %.2f\n", or_limit))

p_or <- ggplot(or_heat, aes(x = tissue, y = miRNA_short, fill = log2OR)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = or_heat %>% filter(sig != "n.s."),
            aes(label = label_sig), size = 3,
            color = "grey20", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = boundary_pos_rev,
             color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "solid") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#d6604d",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "log2(OR)\n\n* FDR < 0.05\n# p < 0.05",
                       limits = c(-or_limit, or_limit),
                       oob = scales::squish) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = length(tissue_order) + 0.6,
           y     = cluster_mid_rev$mid_pos,
           label = paste0("C", cluster_mid_rev$miRNA_cluster),
           size = 3, hjust = 0, color = "grey20", fontface = "bold") +
  coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title    = "Odds ratio: miRNA enrichment per tissue",
    subtitle = "log2(OR); sorted by cluster then n_pairs",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 30, 5, 5),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid      = element_blank()
  )

print(p_or)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "fisher_heatmap_OR.svg"),
       p_or, width = fig_w_heat, height = fig_h_heat, limitsize = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "fisher_heatmap_OR.png"),
       p_or, width = fig_w_heat, height = fig_h_heat, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Saved: fisher_heatmap_OR.svg / .png  (%.1f x %.1f in)\n",
            fig_w_heat, fig_h_heat))
```

# 7. Logistic regression (GLMM)

## Rationale

The union pairs dataset contains **non-independent observations**:

- The same miRNA is paired with multiple mRNAs → pairs sharing a miRNA are
  correlated (miRNA-level clustering).
- The same mRNA target can appear in multiple tissues → pairs sharing a gene
  are correlated (gene-level clustering).

A Generalized Linear Mixed Model (GLMM) with **random intercepts** for
`miRNA_Name` and `SYMBOL` accounts for both sources of non-independence.

For each tissue $j$ (one model per tissue):

$$
\text{logit}\,P(\text{pair} \in \text{tissue}_j) =
  \alpha + u_{\text{miRNA}} + u_{\text{gene}}, \quad
  u_{\text{miRNA}} \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^2_{\text{miRNA}}), \quad
  u_{\text{gene}} \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^2_{\text{gene}})
$$

The **intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC)** for the miRNA random effect:

$$
\text{ICC}_{\text{miRNA}} =
  \frac{\sigma^2_{\text{miRNA}}}
       {\sigma^2_{\text{miRNA}} + \sigma^2_{\text{gene}} + \pi^2/3}
$$

A large ICC$_\text{miRNA}$ means that miRNA identity explains a substantial
fraction of the variance in tissue membership — i.e., **miRNAs are tissue-directed**.

## 7a. Null model (random effects only) — variance decomposition

```{r glmm-null}
glmm_null_results <- map_dfr(tissue_order, function(tis) {

  df <- pairs %>%
    mutate(y = as.integer(tissue == tis)) %>%
    dplyr::select(miRNA_Name, SYMBOL, miRNA_cluster, y)

  n_pos <- sum(df$y)
  n_neg <- nrow(df) - n_pos

  if (n_pos < 3 || n_neg < 3) {
    message("Skipping ", tis, ": too few positive cases (", n_pos, ")")
    return(tibble(tissue = tis, converged = FALSE,
                  sigma2_miRNA = NA, sigma2_gene = NA,
                  icc_miRNA = NA, icc_gene = NA, n_pairs = n_pos))
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    glmer(y ~ 1 + (1 | miRNA_Name) + (1 | SYMBOL),
          data = df, family = binomial,
          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                 optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))),
    error   = function(e) { message(tis, ": ", e$message); NULL },
    warning = function(w) {
      suppressWarnings(
        glmer(y ~ 1 + (1 | miRNA_Name) + (1 | SYMBOL),
              data = df, family = binomial,
              control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                     optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))))
    }
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble(tissue = tis, converged = FALSE,
                  sigma2_miRNA = NA, sigma2_gene = NA,
                  icc_miRNA = NA, icc_gene = NA, n_pairs = n_pos))
  }

  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit))
  s2_mirna <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "miRNA_Name"]
  s2_gene  <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "SYMBOL"]
  denom    <- s2_mirna + s2_gene + (pi^2 / 3)

  tibble(
    tissue       = tis,
    converged    = TRUE,
    n_pairs      = n_pos,
    sigma2_miRNA = round(s2_mirna, 4),
    sigma2_gene  = round(s2_gene,  4),
    icc_miRNA    = round(s2_mirna / denom, 4),
    icc_gene     = round(s2_gene  / denom, 4)
  )
})

cat("GLMM null model — variance components:\n")
print(glmm_null_results)

write.csv(glmm_null_results,
          file.path(out_dir, "glmm_null_variance_components.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: glmm_null_variance_components.csv\n")
```

## 7b. ICC visualisation

```{r icc-plot, fig.height=4, fig.width=7}

  filter(converged) %>%

               names_to  = "source",
               values_to = "icc") %>%
  mutate(
    source = recode(source,
                    icc_miRNA = "miRNA random effect",
                    icc_gene  = "mRNA random effect"),
    tissue = factor(tissue, levels = tissue_order)
  )

p_icc <- ggplot(icc_long,
                aes(x = tissue, y = icc, fill = source)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
           width = 0.65, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +

    title    = "GLMM — Intraclass Correlation Coefficient per tissue",
    subtitle = "ICC\u209c\u1d35\u1d3f\u1d3a\u1d2c: fraction of variance in tissue membership explained by miRNA identity",
    x = NULL, y = "ICC", fill = NULL
  ) +

print(p_icc)

```

## 7c. Full model: miRNA cluster as fixed effect

Tests whether cluster membership (1–5) predicts tissue-specific pairing,
controlling for miRNA and gene non-independence.

$$
\text{logit}\,P(\text{pair} \in \text{tissue}_j) =
  \alpha + \beta_{\text{cluster}} +
  u_{\text{miRNA}} + u_{\text{gene}}
$$

```{r glmm-cluster}
# Reference = cluster with the broadest tissue distribution (lowest mean normalized Tau).
# No miRNA in this dataset falls below TAU_LOW (0.30), so the ubiquitous category
# is empty; the cluster closest to uniform distribution is used instead.
ubiq_ref <- tau_norm_df %>%
  group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(mean_tau = mean(tau, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_min(mean_tau, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  as.character()

cat("Mean normalized Tau per cluster (reference selection):\n")
tau_norm_df %>%
  group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    mean_tau = mean(tau, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_tau) %>%
  print()
cat("Selected reference cluster:", ubiq_ref, "(lowest mean normalized Tau)\n")

pairs_glmm <- pairs %>%
  mutate(miRNA_cluster = relevel(factor(as.character(miRNA_cluster)), ref = ubiq_ref))

glmm_cluster_results <- map_dfr(tissue_order, function(tis) {

  df <- pairs_glmm %>%
    mutate(y = as.integer(tissue == tis)) %>%
    dplyr::select(miRNA_Name, SYMBOL, miRNA_cluster, y)

  n_pos <- sum(df$y)
  if (n_pos < 3) return(NULL)

  # bglmer() adds a weakly informative N(0, 2.5^2) prior on fixed effects,
  # preventing divergence to ±Inf under complete separation.
  fit <- tryCatch(
    bglmer(y ~ miRNA_cluster + (1 | miRNA_Name) + (1 | SYMBOL),
           data = df, family = binomial,
           fixef.prior = normal(sd = 2.5),
           control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                  optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))),
    error   = function(e) { message(tis, ": ", e$message); NULL },
    warning = function(w) suppressWarnings(
      bglmer(y ~ miRNA_cluster + (1 | miRNA_Name) + (1 | SYMBOL),
             data = df, family = binomial,
             fixef.prior = normal(sd = 2.5),
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))))
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(tissue = tis)
})

if (!is.null(glmm_cluster_results) && nrow(glmm_cluster_results) > 0) {

  glmm_cluster_results <- glmm_cluster_results %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj    = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
      sig      = case_when(
        p_adj   < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
        p.value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
        TRUE           ~ "n.s."
      ),
      cluster  = sub("miRNA_cluster", "Cluster ", term),
      tissue   = factor(tissue, levels = tissue_order)
    )

  cat("GLMM cluster fixed effects (significant FDR < 0.05):\n")
  glmm_cluster_results %>%
    filter(sig != "n.s.") %>%
    dplyr::select(tissue, cluster, estimate, std.error,
                  p.value, p_adj, sig) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    print(n = Inf)

  write.csv(glmm_cluster_results,
            file.path(out_dir, "glmm_cluster_fixed_effects.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
  cat("Saved: glmm_cluster_fixed_effects.csv\n")

  # Dot plot: cluster fixed effects per tissue
  p_clust <- ggplot(glmm_cluster_results,
                    aes(x = tissue, y = estimate,
                        color = sig, shape = sig)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                  width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FDR < 0.05" = "#d6604d",
                                  "p < 0.05"   = "#f4a582",
                                  "n.s."        = "grey60")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("FDR < 0.05" = 8,
                                  "p < 0.05"   = 21,
                                  "n.s."        = 16)) +
    facet_wrap(~ cluster, nrow = 1) +
    labs(
      title    = "GLMM — Cluster fixed effects on tissue membership",
      subtitle = paste0("Estimate = log-odds coefficient; error bars = 95% CI; reference = Cluster ", ubiq_ref, " (lowest mean normalized Tau; broadest tissue distribution)"),
      x = NULL, y = paste0("log-odds (vs Cluster ", ubiq_ref, ")"),
      color = "Significance", shape = "Significance"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )

  print(p_clust)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "glmm_cluster_effects_dotplot.svg"),
         p_clust, width = 10, height = 5)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "glmm_cluster_effects_dotplot.png"),
         p_clust, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  cat("Saved: glmm_cluster_effects_dotplot.svg / .png\n")

} else {
  cat("No GLMM cluster results (convergence failure or insufficient data)\n")
}
```

# 8. Integrated summary table

Combine Tau index, Fisher enrichment, and GLMM ICC per miRNA.

```{r summary-table}
# Best tissue per miRNA from Fisher (lowest p_adj)
best_tissue_fisher <- fisher_results %>%
  group_by(miRNA_Name) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = p_adj, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA_Name,
                fisher_top_tissue  = tissue,
                fisher_OR          = odds_ratio,
                fisher_p           = p_value,
                fisher_p_adj       = p_adj,
                fisher_sig         = sig)

# GLMM: tissue with highest ICC_miRNA
glmm_top <- glmm_null_results %>%
  filter(converged) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = icc_miRNA, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(glmm_top_tissue = tissue,
                glmm_icc_miRNA  = icc_miRNA)

summary_table <- tau_df %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster, tau, n_total,
                n_tissues, specificity, top_tissue) %>%
  left_join(best_tissue_fisher, by = "miRNA_Name") %>%
  left_join(glmm_top %>% mutate(dummy = 1),
            by = character())    # broadcast GLMM top tissue to all miRNAs

cat("Integrated summary:\n")
summary_table %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster, tau, specificity,
                top_tissue, fisher_top_tissue, fisher_sig,
                glmm_top_tissue, glmm_icc_miRNA) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

write.csv(summary_table,
          file.path(out_dir, "miRNA_tissue_specificity_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: miRNA_tissue_specificity_summary.csv\n")
```
